error_categories.description: The trace answers a max-discrepancy question over four stores (Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, Albertsons) but only computes values for Whole Foods and Walmart. It never evaluates or rules out Target and Albertsons, so the claimed maximum is not justified.

The key percentage values for chart readings are stated as direct observations from unseen video/charts (e.g., Whole Foods cleanliness 80%, Walmart cleanliness 30%, Whole Foods value 15%, Walmart value 70%) without any explicit tool-attributed textual source. In text-only mode, these media-grounded values are unsupported.

summary: The trace reaches a clear conclusion, but text-only verification fails because its core chart values are unsupported direct media claims and it does not compare all four required stores. Therefore the final answer is not justified from the trace text alone.
